description.about: A full-stack, AI-powered mission-planning web app built for the IBM AI Builders Challenge (Space Exploration track). It parses free-text satellite mission descriptions into structured requirements, then filters, ranks, and explains trade-offs across a launch-vehicle catalog.

description.impact: Turns a free-text mission description into a ranked, explained shortlist of launch vehicles. The test suite covers both the AI path and the deterministic fallback, so the app still works with no API key.
